description: Evaluate instruction quality across the bot/behavior/action chain. Checks for duplicated text, wordiness, vague language, and inconsistencies between instruction levels.

do.description: Keep instructions concise, specific, and consistent across levels

guidance.description: Each instruction level (behavior, action, base action) should have a distinct purpose. Behavior sets context, action gives specific steps, base action provides the template.
example: Behavior: 'Create a story map capturing user journeys through epics and stories'
Action: 'Gather context for story mapping' (specific to clarify)
Base action: 'Review context, answer each question, save to clarification.json' (reusable template)

dont.description: Do not duplicate instructions across levels or use vague language

guidance.description: Same instruction text repeated at behavior and action level adds noise. Vague words like 'consider', 'might', 'should probably' weaken guidance.
example: Duplicate: behavior says 'validate story structure' AND action says 'validate story structure'
Vague: 'You might want to consider checking the story names' -> 'Check each story name follows verb-noun format'
